# Answers to even-numbered exercises {#sec-appendix-even-answers}

The worked solutions of [Appendix -@sec-exercise-solutions] cover the odd-numbered exercises, following the convention of *Introduction to Modern Statistics*.
This appendix gives **final answers** for the even-numbered exercises — values, classifications, and verdicts, with at most a clause of justification and never the full worked reasoning — so that a self-studying reader can check every attempt while the exercises remain usable as assigned work.
If your number disagrees, re-read the exercise's stated frame and seed before doubting your method: in this book, most wrong answers are right answers to a different frame.
